#India has reported at least eight cases of human metapneumovirus (#HMPV) across multiple states, including Maharashtra, Karnataka, Gujarat, and Jharkhand.

#Mumbai reported another HMPV case on Wednesday, adding to the rising count of respiratory illness cases nationwide.

In Jharkhand, Health Minister Dr. Irfan Ansari directed the #Health Department to stay vigilant and deploy medical teams at key locations like railway stations and airports to screen travelers.

Bengaluru, Karnataka, reported two cases on Monday, while Gujarat confirmed a third case after #hospitalization.
The increase in HMPV cases coincides with a broader rise in respiratory illnesses in India and globally, including outbreaks of viral fever and pneumonia in neighboring countries like #China.
